proposed_widenings.name: feat_record
proposed_widenings.justification: No UnitRecord kind for 'feat' exists. The surface defines only spell, class_feature, and mastery records. A feat is a distinct kind with prerequisites, multiple independent benefit buckets, and no single mechanics family mapping to existing families.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) — grants Ability Score Increase, Overcome Defenses, and Overwhelming Strike as distinct, structurally independent benefits.

proposed_widenings.name: crit_window
proposed_widenings.justification: Overwhelming Strike triggers specifically on a natural 20, not on any hit. The v4 taxonomy explicitly records crit_window as a deferred single-feat pressure case for this exact feat. on_hit_window cannot distinguish a critical hit from an ordinary hit.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat.

proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount: ability_score_value
proposed_widenings.justification: Overwhelming Strike's damage equals the character's current STR or DEX score (the one boosted by the feat) — a flat integer derived from a runtime stat. No existing DiceAmount variant (fixed, threshold_tiers, linear_per_level) can express a value that references a character ability score.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat

proposed_widenings.name: passive_benefit (bypass_resistance, always-on)
proposed_widenings.justification: Overcome Defenses is an always-on passive — no activation, no trigger, no quota consumed. The bypass_resistance v4 atom exists, but the current surface has no passive benefit carrier. All existing ClassFeatureEffect variants are activated effects, not passive always-on modifiers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no 'feat' kind in UnitRecord. Feats have multi-bucket benefit structures (ability score increase + passive modification + conditional on-hit rider) that are not reducible to any existing mechanics family. Secondary blockers: crit_window (deferred in TAXONOMY v4 §12, explicitly cited for this feat), ability-score-as-flat-damage DiceAmount variant, and passive benefit carrier for always-on effects. The Ability Score Increase sub-benefit (modify_ability_score) is also out of scope per TAXONOMY v4 §12.
